scope.provenance_claim: Image byte identity is verified below. This review does not independently certify whole-film export provenance or phase 5/SHIP.

method: Opened all original s*.jpg sheets via view_image, every row and cell; no frame sampling within the assigned interval.
Read each chunk INFO word/cue markers before adjudication; cue metadata and envelope strips are not treated as hearing audio.
Opened 17 canonical raw JPEGs at entire 960x540 frame view for punch freeze, B08 text/camera, Threads hold and app entrance.
Hashed all 30 sheets before and after inspection; all matched. All opened raw JPEG hashes recorded.
Read local source only to establish the clock cause of verified repeated punch poses. No source, VERDICT or JURI writes; no rendering.
limitations: No audio playback or claim of hearing SFX/VO from envelope strips.
Sheet cells are small; uncertain details were checked in 960x540 canonical raw JPEGs, not original 1920x1080 render pixels.
This assigned interval ends at f899; B13 push/typing after f899 and all tail frames are outside this report.
Static every-frame images show pose continuity; natural-speed perceptual severity of the short opening freeze remains a native-playback judgment.

findings.scope: cadence; tidak mengubah triad verb, footage arsip, layout atau wording yang sudah disetujui
findings.source_cause: Main memakai Freeze frame W(f); W membulatkan scene time; Archive/archCam membaca useCurrentFrame lama sehingga pose old162/163 berulang.
findings.recommendation: Lead dapat menilai cadence f142–154 pada playback native sebelum memutuskan polish lokal. Bila terlihat menahan punch, jalankan archCam/blur lokal dengan actual clock dan anchor cut yang sama; jangan mengubah peta global atau memperluas desain.

scope_observations.blank_export: No blank export observed in any of the 900 inspected cells.
scope_observations.foreground_text: No new unintended foreground word clipping, destructive text overlap or camera-bound crop confirmed in this interval. Opening punch deliberately carries old label through frame edge; its repeated blurred pose is the cadence observation.
scope_observations.youtube_dummy: B08 wall f433–476 and YouTube search f701–776 show flat vector thumbnails and generic creator placeholders; no new photographic creator thumbnail/avatar leak observed. Real archive footage at start and Irfan face inserts are intentional approved context.
scope_observations.B08: All f433–486 cells inspected; raw f450/464/473/476/486 show full captions, fall/camera motion continuing, no teleport. The white label at f450 overlays a dummy card but all caption words remain visible. End phrase held before f487 cut.
scope_observations.Threads: Foreground quote is sharp and complete after push and held through f653. BEKU f561 is settled reading context.
scope_observations.ChatGPT_in_scope: Desktop cut f834, window entrance from dock f862–868, then wide framing through f899. No zoom-out/reset observed here. The single B13 heavy push and typing are later than this interval and are not re-certified by this report.
scope_observations.intentional_baseline: Anticipatory empty NCard lead and repeated triad verb holds were not converted into style findings.
